expected_findings.label: Heat treatment changes elongation at the selected fixed SLM condition
expected_findings.claim: At 120 W / 100 mm/s, furnace HT and HIP increase reported elongation relative to as-SLM while lowering reported strength; the ± statistic type remains unspecified.

expected_findings.label: Heat treatment lowers residual stress in the selected stratum
expected_findings.claim: The selected 120 W / 100 mm/s measurements report lower residual stress after furnace HT or HIP than as-SLM.
expected_findings.scope: selected condition, not all Table 2 rows

expected_findings.label: The process matrix associates higher energy-density settings with higher density
expected_findings.claim: Across the jointly varied power/speed matrix, density and pore observations change with the reported energy-density settings.

abstentions.reason: Wear tests cover selected 120 W speed strata only; unlisted Table 2 combinations are uninspected, not negative results.
Laser power and scan speed co-vary, so the compact gold does not support an isolated causal claim for derived energy density.
The conventional cold-rolled control is a route context comparator, not a matched SLM post-treatment counterfactual.

technical_failure_guard.rule: A parser timeout, malformed JSON response, or unavailable model call must increase failed_source_count and leave scientific findings unchanged; it must never be encoded as a negative measurement or a scientific abstention.
